About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services in strategy and consulting, interactive, technology, and operations, powered by exceptional digital capabilities across all of these areas. With deep industry expertise, a culture of innovation, and a commitment to delivering value, we help organizations navigate complexity and transform with confidence.

Accenture is consistently recognized globally not only for business performance, but also for our strong commitment to equality and belonging.
"Across the globe, one thing is universally true of the people of Accenture: We care deeply about what we do and the impact we have with our clients and with the communities in which we work and live. It is personal to all of us."
Julie Sweet, Accenture CEO
Introduction
At Accenture Security, we are seeking an accomplished CrowdStrike Security Architect to strengthen our Cyber Defense and Resilience practice. We are looking for a cybersecurity professional with proven experience in security operations transformation, CrowdStrike Falcon platform implementations, and client-facing advisory engagements.
The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise across endpoint security, NG-SIEM, identity protection, cloud security, exposure management, and AI-enabled security capabilities with the ability to guide strategic cybersecurity initiatives. This role requires a trusted advisor who can bridge business and technical priorities, helping clients modernize their security operations, consolidate technologies, and achieve measurable cyber resilience outcomes.
Working at the intersection of Accenture's consulting excellence and CrowdStrike's technology leadership, you will help leading organizations accelerate their security transformation journeys while contributing to innovative cybersecurity offerings and solutions.
What's in It for You
Partner with leading organizations to modernize and transform security operations through AI-powered cyber defense.
Collaborate with Accenture's CrowdStrike Business Group and global cybersecurity specialists.
Influence strategic security decisions and large-scale cyber transformation initiatives.
Shape innovative CrowdStrike-focused offerings and contribute to market-leading solutions.
Access continuous learning, certifications, and the latest cybersecurity technologies.
Key Responsibilities
Lead discovery sessions with CISOs, SOC leaders, and security architects to assess current security capabilities, identify gaps, and align Falcon platform solutions to business outcomes.
Design and deliver CrowdStrike Falcon solution demonstrations, architecture designs, business value assessments, and executive presentations tailored to client requirements.
Serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout pre-sales engagements and enterprise cybersecurity transformation initiatives.
Guide organizations through security operations modernization, platform consolidation, and cyber resilience programs leveraging CrowdStrike technologies.
Contribute to the growth of Accenture's CrowdStrike offerings through innovation, thought leadership, and opportunity development activities.
Necessary Knowledge / Skills
Demonstrated experience in solution architecture, cybersecurity consulting, or technical delivery roles within the cybersecurity industry.
Hands-on expertise with the CrowdStrike Falcon platform, including endpoint protection, EDR, NG-SIEM, Exposure Management (CTEM), Identity Protection, Cloud Security, and Charlotte AI.
Strong technical knowledge across multiple security domains such as SIEM technologies, endpoint security, cloud security, identity threat detection, and vulnerability or exposure management.
Broad understanding of enterprise security architectures, including cloud platforms, hybrid infrastructures, identity ecosystems, and operational technology environments.
Excellent communication, consulting, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business outcomes for executive audiences.
Preferred Qualifications
Active CrowdStrike certifications such as CCFA, CCSE, or CrowdStrike Champions Professional/Expert credentials.
Experience delivering CrowdStrike NG-SIEM implementations, migrations, parser development, CQL use cases, or LogScale administration.
Background in managed security services, MSSP/MDR environments, or large-scale security operations programs.
Experience with CTEM methodologies, attack surface management, vulnerability prioritization platforms, and exposure reduction initiatives.
Familiarity with security frameworks and threat intelligence practices, including NIST CSF, SOC 2, ISO 27001, DORA, HIPAA, FedRAMP, MITRE ATT&CK, and adversary tracking.
